list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides below are written for this entry in our own words; each cites the sources its facts come from.
sources_note: PowerPyx = GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com). Planet GTA 6 = GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies (planetgta6.com), which reports the official list from Exophase and PSNProfiles. KeenGamer = GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (keengamer.com). Sixshore = GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List (sixshore.com).

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in this guide: finish the story, then the 100% completion checklist, then the remaining side strands and clean-up trophies. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, all in a single playthrough with no online trophies.

It cannot be missed: every story mission is part of the main path and there is no mission replay, but the story itself always carries you through it.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins. Chapter 2 is also where the game opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together, which is what unlocks the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and the character-specific questlines. Nothing in this chapter can lock you out of the platinum.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — it only becomes visible after the story, but anything you did during the story already counts toward it. The good news is that it is far more forgiving than it sounds: PowerPyx describes it as closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests are not required, and of the collectibles you typically need only part of each set — for example 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. The only things that need doing in full are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be finished in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the story to unlock Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work through the checklist in free-roam; nothing on it is missable.
Complete all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges.

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — the 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there. Stunts come in four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. PowerPyx calls the under-bridge flights the quickest to farm. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt has its own name and stays marked once done.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — the trophy tracker counts them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. The nine are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. PowerPyx notes you will meet most of them through the story and the rest are marked with blue icons when you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide and notes the gold medals are not too difficult — and the ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. The 100% checklist needs the ranges done too, so do them as part of the clean-up rather than as a separate grind.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total, three per location. PowerPyx has a location guide for all 14, and the 100% checklist also requires the drone races, so this is a clean-up trophy rather than a side quest. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then push for the win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location only counts once, so you need 20 distinct ones out of the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Any race type counts, and a win in a Top Fun drone race or a race challenge also counts toward the activity set for Master of None. Work through the map's race markers in free-roam after the story, starting with the easiest circuits.

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — you can do this as early as Chapter 1 — while Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville marking the questline on the map. It stays available after the story, so there is no rush. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for him, he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure-diving for shipwrecks — find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back to his shop. There are seven shipwrecks in total across several sets. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable in later chapters, but he always comes back (playing as Jason, calling Brian in Chapter 2 speeds it up), so the questline is not missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Not every side questline counts — PowerPyx confirms that the questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy, even though they have their own trophies. The confirmed counting strands are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: Skunk Apeology 101, searching for tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street racing and mentoring quests) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his delivery quests) — with more strangers still being discovered. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him using the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in the west of Vice City (green RK icon). He marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can also steal any of them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is on his list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. Sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go to them and destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down; finishing it pops the trophy. It all stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations. Each spot can be done with both Jason and Lucia, counting as two meditations at the same place, and you can track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Two things to know: you cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), and the 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots. This is the game's one potentially missable trophy — see the warning below.
trophies.missable_reason: Potentially missable: the first meditation is offered only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. It is not yet confirmed whether this meditation is required for the trophy, but PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do that quest and he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest (it can be retrieved from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker), and a clean one-shot kill keeps the animal in pristine condition for more money. It stays available after the story, and his 15 Target Decks are also part of the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally during clean-up. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed by PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app: hold the phone's scan button and aim at the object. Any 100 count, out of 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures (plus No Flusher tags). Scan everything unfamiliar as you play — vehicles, landmarks, odd sights — and the trophy comes naturally; the WAiNK app is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good and check Randy's wishlist cars.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. There are eight groups of ten, and you can view and track them under Progress > Challenges. Most of them complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist — which needs 70 of the 80, so this trophy pops on the way there. When you are nearly done, pick the easiest remaining challenges from the list rather than grinding the hardest ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest this can be done is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can roam with both characters — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (causing carnage will do it), then escape the red heat zone. PowerPyx's easiest escape is to drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the heat zone. It also tends to pop on its own during the Chapter 4 bank-vault robberies, which always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner to join you.
Raise a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside (available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — you must keep the flashing red/blue wanted level and not lose it between shops. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items (Zombix/Adrenaline) from an Ammu-Nation. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies

steps: Call your partner to join you.
Rob three shops in a row without losing the wanted level.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the trophy to pop.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and the fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad to open it, then hold R1 to scan a vehicle you are looking at. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops automatically on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies

steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan vehicles as they pass.
100 unique vehicles discovered earns the trophy.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first — eat and drink, wash up or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slow-time window. Line up five enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor from an Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto weapon such as the Duke 556 assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang enemies. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and you will likely reach level 4 naturally while doing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies

steps: Buff focus with food, drink and Adrenaline.
Find five gang enemies grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down all five.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge, whose door leads straight inside. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (it is slightly delayed). You can also walk in through the terminal, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps: Go to VCIA and find a large plane docked at terminals E3/E4.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). They are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — get into a tank and fire at some enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors. Then break into a jewelry store through its back door using the Snap Gun — never kick the door, which triggers the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good location.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies

steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun — do not kick it.
Loot the safe, destroy the footage, disable the alarm, then leave.

trophies.guide: Rob any five bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all of it alone. After that quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips about security vans (you need his earlier Payday Loan jobs done first); the vans are marked with purple icons. Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake recognition. There are eight large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all eight, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani and follow the vans to banks.
Rob five vaults and escape each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is… — tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. If you want it earlier, you can also find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are available in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 — it counts automatically.
Or stop an armored truck near a bank, blow its back door with a sticky bomb, and escape.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map by visiting all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every part of the map still covered in black fog until the whole map is visible. Do this late in the game, when you have a good plane and the map is mostly open, and it is a quick trophy.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every fogged part of the map until all 52 areas are revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are also marked automatically from story progress. You only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it pops on the way there. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find gang operations (yellow map icons) across Leonida.
Rob one operation for each of the nine gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops as you enjoy the view — a simple one, and a nice breather between the bigger grinds.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take the car after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — hack into the Banshee, then drive forward through the glass. The trophy pops a moment later, once you are out on the street. It only works with this specific blue Banshee, not any other car — PowerPyx notes it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS).
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and hack the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You first go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow open the safe. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what is left — it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling).
Steal the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This is only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always train with both characters together (hold right on the D-pad and press Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Fitness clubs are marked on the map under Activities, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Always train with both characters together.
Raise both to maximum strength.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count out of 500. Turn on criminal-profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so you see a small demon face on screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy robberies and clean escapes push you toward Professional, incapacitating enemies toward Hardened, killing toward Violent, and mass killing toward Psycho — while the Irredeemable profile is permanent and best avoided, since police become far more aggressive. You will almost certainly reach 500 naturally while doing the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts; if you are short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and police with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally — robberies and encounters all count toward 500.
Check the trophy tracker for your count.

trophies.guide: This one is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. The store is in Vice City, Little Cuba. Until a guide confirms the exact trigger, do not grind it: the description itself suggests a second attempt at something, so keep this trophy in mind when you pass the Payday Loans store and try interacting with it again later in the game. This guide will be updated here if a source confirms the method.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, and come alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside as she asks. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

Look for the blinking car; if absent, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the woman, return to her car.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick ten pedestrians with the Square button within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach, where there are always people on the sidewalks. Keep moving and kicking — ten kicks inside a minute is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Get on any bike in a crowded area (Vice City or Ocean Beach).
Kick ten pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once, and it comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist: a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 total to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most).

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is buying the most expensive things: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios. Clothing, footwear, hair and electronics shops all count too. This comes naturally over a full playthrough, especially once you start buying gear for the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Spend $100,000 total in shops.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to reach it.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages (there are also four story-related garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through the app. The fastest money comes from robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. Garages also add parking spots, which you need for registering vehicles in On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all eight purchasable garages ($160,000 total).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses. The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps: Buy garages first to add parking spots.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
Register ten vehicles in total.
